notes.title: 🛠️ Graphical Update Now Live!
notes.content: [p]Hello bridge adventurers![/p][p]We’re excited to announce a [b]major visual upgrade[/b] to [i]Bridge Crossing[/i]! The world now looks sharper, richer, and more immersive than ever. Whether you're a seasoned crosser or just starting your journey, this update brings a fresh layer of depth to every step you take.[/p][p]✨ [b]What’s New?[/b][/p][list][*][p]Enhanced textures for environments and structures[/p][/*][*][p]More dynamic and realistic lighting[/p][/*][*][p]Refreshed visual effects for greater atmosphere[/p][/*][*][p]Sleek and modernized interface[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44450997/06df7f0984af45f9b1eb5a007c58b83d30879c20.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p]This graphical overhaul is designed to elevate your experience and make each crossing feel more alive. We’ve poured a lot of care into these improvements, and we can’t wait for you to see them in action.[/p][p]🔧 Update now and enjoy the view![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44450997/2fe21394f378aa2b548c7ea810c5060cdfe3669e.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44450997/1669521f0dba6d2a3d1165884a8e2f205a0cf59c.png"][/img][/p][p]Thanks for being part of the [i]Bridge Crossing[/i] community. Your feedback keeps us moving forward — so keep it coming![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44450997/fc0104dc85b6345dfd0a5fd851775eb5249ba0ef.png"][/img][/p]
